name: demo-qa-workflow
description: Demo: testing a multi-step user onboarding workflow with Bruno

scripts.test:success: cd bruno && bru run user-onboarding --env success --reporter-html ../reports/success.html
scripts.test:fail-last: cd bruno && bru run user-onboarding --env fail-last-step --reporter-html ../reports/fail-last-step.html
scripts.test:fail-otp: cd bruno && bru run user-onboarding --env fail-otp --reporter-html ../reports/fail-otp.html
scripts.test:all: npm run test:success; npm run test:fail-last; npm run test:fail-otp; npm run test:data-driven
scripts.test:data-driven: cd bruno-data-driven && bru run onboard-user --env local --csv-file-path data/users.csv --reporter-html ../reports/data-driven.html
scripts.test:mock-success: cd bruno-mock && bru run user-onboarding --env mock-success --reporter-html ../reports/mock-success.html
scripts.test:mock-fail-last: cd bruno-mock && bru run user-onboarding --env mock-fail-last-step --reporter-html ../reports/mock-fail-last-step.html
scripts.test:mock-fail-otp: cd bruno-mock && bru run user-onboarding --env mock-fail-otp --reporter-html ../reports/mock-fail-otp.html
